Attached: 4 images

Hey all,
Has anyone done like this,taking a task and not finishing them like this
“Just a quick 30-minute task.”
An hour later…😅

I built Personal Planner because my estimates needed a reality check.

Block time → start a timer → compare planned vs actual → learn for tomorrow.

Free. Open source. Works offline.
No account needed for local use.
Windows, Linux, macOS & Android.

Try it for one day. Which task surprised you?
https://karthikshabari.github.io/PersonalPlanner/

#OpenSource #Productivity #TimeBlocking #Flutter
